findings.lane_level_optimum_found: 35 Xor3Lane gates = 10 auxiliary + 25 outputs (verified on 500 random states)
findings.bit_level_equivalent: 10 aux lane-gates x 64 bits = 640 helpers = the standing record, score 184320
findings.node_cycle: Column-slices (x,b) form a single 320-cycle under (x,b)->(x+2,b-1); each slice-seed is an edge.
findings.why_640_is_tight: 5 atoms per node = exactly 2 fanin-3 gates (3 then +2); target weight 11 = exactly 1 rider + 5 + 5 = 3 slots. Every count is saturated.
findings.analogue_3col: 3-column w=1 analogue DOES admit 5 helpers instead of 6 (corpus 9->8 reproduced and verified).
findings.analogue_3col_is_not_faithful: the saving needs the rider node of an edge to coincide with the far endpoint of the adjacent edge, i.e. rider offset k == 2 on the node cycle. Measured k: 3-col w=1 -> k=2 (coincidence holds); ALL 5-column instances -> k = 3 mod 5 (w=1 k=3, w=2 k=8, w=4 k=8, w=64 k=128). Since 3 != 2 mod 5 the coincidence CANNOT occur for Keccak theta at any w.
